title: ECMAScript specifies execution contexts, functions, objects, and control abstractions
locator: Clauses 9, 15, and 20: Executable Code and Execution Contexts; Functions and Classes; Control Abstraction Objects
paraphrase: ECMAScript defines execution contexts and lexical environments, function creation and calls, objects and properties, and control abstractions that expose scope, lifetime, parameter, return, collection, and failure behavior.
scope: Language-specific evidence for Volume 01 function, scope, decomposition, collection, record, recursion, text, and error concepts; general engineering guidance requires independent sources.
